# Ephe

> Ephe is an ephemeral SI agent (Super Intelligence) — offline-first, private, local.
> Built by Bemler Labs. BUSL-1.1.

## What is Ephe?
Ephe runs entirely locally on your device: CLI (TUI), desktop app
(Tauri) and PWA. The agent runs on the engine you chose — local Ollama
is a first-class offline option and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is
equally first-class; which model tag runs inside is your choice and
Ephe names none for you (`ephe configure`, or `EPHE_MODEL`), has no cloud backend and
never leaves your data — no telemetry endpoint, no tracking.

## Core capabilities
- **Chat & agent loop:** local LLM requests via Ollama (or an
  OpenAI-compatible endpoint), SSE streaming, tool calling.
- **Computer use / tools:** the `ephe tool` subcommand with an approval gate,
  diff preview, `--dry-run` (threat model E1); whitelisted commands
  (ls/cat/python/git/docker/…), block patterns (rm -rf, sudo, …).
- **Skills:** /chart, /deck, /pdf, i18n prompts; skills are extensible.
- **Memory:** an on-device store plus a session store;
  the PWA persists chat via IndexedDB (client-side).
- **Vision & audio:** screenshots/vision via Ollama vision models;
  speech via local Piper TTS when it is installed, otherwise the opt-in cloud service.

## Documentation & sources

## For LLM agents (usage notes)
- API/CLI configuration: `EPHE_MODEL`, `EPHE_MODEL_PROVIDER`,
  `EPHE_OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL`, `EPHE_OFFLINE`.
- Backend port: 127.0.0.1:8765 (LAN only opt-in via `--lan`); web UI on
  port 5173 (Vite dev) or bundled into the desktop app.
- This PWA is an SPA (React 19, hash router: Landing / Onboarding /
  Chat); dynamic content runs client-side against the local
  backend API. Crawler rules: see robots.txt.

## Skill & Automation references
- Skill pack format + install API: docs/SKILL_PACKS.md (offline curated pack index: skills/pack-index.json)
- Automation presets & run history: GET /api/schedule/presets, /api/schedule/results (R19)
- Memory API: /api/memory/list|search|export|import (R19; auto-memory is toggle-gated via memory_enabled)
- CLI reference: docs/CLI.md
- Voice setup (local Piper TTS, faster-whisper STT): docs/VOICE.md
